text:
maria: quick async pulse — what I did / blockers / today
- did: triaged recent audit findings, kicked off a staging KMS rotation dry-run, merged small audit-tool fix
- blockers: waiting for cross-account IAM role approval (security review), staging smoke failing on one decrypt path
- today: review @josh's dryrun logs, coordinate IAM policy change with @arjun, schedule rotation window once smoke is green

josh: KMS dryrun completed in staging. one instance failed with `AccessDeniedException` during decrypt. pushed branch `fix/kms-decrypt-retry` and opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/478 — please review when you can. cc @maria

maria: thanks. can you paste the failing command / log snippet here?

josh: sure — failing command and log:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://payload.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
Error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/model-serving-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
Added a retry wrapper in the branch to avoid flakes but we need the role change.

arjun: I can take the IAM review. do we intend the model-serving task to `sts:AssumeRole` into key-ops, or should we add `kms:Decrypt` directly to the model-serving role? leaning toward short-lived assume role for cross-account separation. will post a policy diff shortly.

kelly: audit note: two ECS tasks still reference old key ARN in env var `APP_KEY_ARN` — opening remediation PR to update to alias and add fallback. also flagged a transitive dependency that surfaced a CVE (CVE-2026-1234) — patch scheduled tonight, tracking in Jira SEC-1341.

lisa: staging smoke failing on canary because config decrypt failed. queued hotfix to fall back to public config to keep canary alive while we fix KMS. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/services/pull/1023

maria: thanks @lisa. @arjun please post the proposed trust policy + minimal kms permissions. @josh ensure the infra PR documents the rollout steps and rollback plan. once PRs land and smoke is green I'll schedule the rotation window.

opsbot: INCIDENT CREATED — #INC-2026-042 KMS rotation staging smoke failure. assigned eng-security, oncall paged, sev: low, follow up in incident channel.

arjun: quick Q — will we need `iam:PassRole` for the controller that performs assume-role? propose policy: allow `sts:AssumeRole` on role/key-ops and `kms:Decrypt` scoped to alias. posting diff in a sec.

josh: added smoke test retry (3 attempts with exponential backoff) to reduce flakes. included test logs in the PR description. PTAL @maria

maria: reading both PRs now, left a couple inline comments. thumbs up on retry approach. thanks everyone — will do another async update when rotation window is scheduled. :thumbsup:

lisa: noted — will monitor canary and escalate if additional failures.

josh: pinging for review reminder — infra PR still needs one more approval before merge.

arjun: posted policy diff link in thread (infra/docs) and added rationale for assume-role separation.

maria: approved the docs change, leaving a follow-up to confirm cross-account audit logging. signing off for now — will DM if anything urgent comes up.
